scope: Automated checks of the supplied application code and tested paths. Not a device-wide audit.

checks.label: Keep default consent off and avoid persistent browser storage
Handle tested scenarios without Python file writes or request logs
Exclude identifiers, exact values and scores from the AI payload
Bypass configured proxies for the local AI request
Reject redirects from the local AI request
Use no-store responses and reject unexpected hostnames
Retrieve authored suggestions without a network connection
Require opt-in before contacting the AI service
Calculate predictions without a network connection
Calculate prepared SHAP explanations without a network connection

limits: File-write checks observe Python file-open APIs in tested prediction/support handlers, not all operating-system writes.
LLM transport tests use mocks; a live Ollama service and its downstream network/logging are not audited.
Static frontend checks and response headers are tested; browser extension behavior, caches outside app control and memory erasure are not certified.
This report applies to the fingerprinted build; run again after code changes.
